body: Hi all, our nightly import job keeps getting 429 Too Many Requests from your API and then fails halfway. Is there a setting on your side we can raise, or do we need to change how the job calls you? We are on the Enterprise plan if that matters.
subject: 429s from the API during our nightly import

body: Since about 9 this morning every ETA for our inbound loads has shifted by several hours. Dispatch is panicking. Did you push something to tracking?
subject: ETAs jumped after this morning's update

body: We need to rotate the API key for our TMS integration this week. What happens to the old key when we generate a new one? We cannot afford any downtime on the integration.
subject: Rotating an API key safely

body: One of our developers pushed our production API key to a public repo about an hour ago. We have already deleted the commit. Please tell us how long the old key keeps working after we rotate it and whether you can look at the key for us.
subject: Key committed to a public repo

body: Our geofence alerts used to ping dispatch when trucks reached depot B. Nothing for the last week. We drew the fence ourselves, radius about 40m.
subject: Yard alerts stopped at depot B

body: rule enabled, trucks arrive, no alert. help
subject: geofence rule not triggering

body: Hello, our Northbound Freight feed has been returning 401 Unauthorized since about 6 this morning. Nothing changed on our side as far as I know. Did you change something?
subject: Northbound feed returns 401 since 6am

body: the carrier is rejecting our login for the feed, says invalid credentials. we did not change anything. who rotates these?
subject: carrier says our credentials are bad

body: A handful of our loads show an ETA that is clearly wrong, it moved a lot after Tuesday. Is something broken on your side or is it us?
subject: ETA looks off on a few loads

body: Last week we waited well beyond our contractual response time on a P2 and nobody told us. We would like to understand if we are entitled to a service credit and how we ask for one.
subject: Credit for the missed response time

body: Can you resync our Northbound feed? Every shipment event shows up twice since the carrier gateway update. We need the duplicates gone before the customs audit.
subject: Please resync our Northbound feed

body: We would like a re-sync of our carrier feed please: duplicate shipment events on every update since Monday.
subject: Re-sync request for duplicate events

body: Hi, we need a re sync on our carrier feed, tracking updates are arriving twice for all shipments.
subject: need a re sync of the feed

body: Please resynchronise our Pioneer Parcel feed. The duplicates on the tracking page are making our customers think shipments are moving twice as fast.
subject: Resynchronise the Pioneer Parcel feed

body: Every single shipment update arrives twice in our dashboard since Monday. Same timestamp, same status, just doubled up. Can someone look?
subject: Every update arrives twice

body: Could you reload our carrier connection from scratch? We are seeing doubled-up tracking updates and think the connection is in a bad state.
subject: Reload the carrier connection from scratch

body: Our webhook endpoint was down for most of Sunday. How many times do you retry a failed delivery and over how long a period, so we know whether we lost events?
subject: How many times do you retry a failed webhook?

body: If our receiver is unreachable for a day, are failed webhooks re-sent automatically and for how long before you give up?
subject: Do missed webhooks get re-sent

body: Our dock lets two trucks into the same door in a slot. What exactly is the slot length the capacity limit applies to?
subject: What is the slot length for capacity limits?

body: Door capacity doesn't seem to be enforced per time slot for us. How long is a slot in your system and when do changes take effect?
subject: Door capacity not enforced per slot

body: Our ERP calculates a total that is 30 cents different from your invoice. Is this a bug? We would like to know the maximum difference we should expect.
subject: Invoice total is 30 cents off

body: why is the invoice total different from what our system computes? it is only cents but finance is asking
subject: why does your invoice differ from ours by cents

body: Our carrier feed has not delivered anything since around midnight. Last update was 23:40. The feed shows as failing. Please advise.
subject: Feed stuck since last night

body: No shipment events have come through our carrier feed for about 40 minutes. It is usually busy at this hour.
subject: No events for 40 minutes

body: The carrier keeps answering our feed requests with 429 and now we are behind on updates. What should we change?
subject: Carrier is throttling our feed

body: A load shows no scan events since this morning. Should we wait or is this something you need to investigate?
subject: Scan events missing on load 55813

body: Bookings made in your tool show up in our Outlook calendar many hours later. How long is this supposed to take and what can we do?
subject: Calendar entries arrive hours late

body: We would like to use SAML single sign-on for our sandbox tenant so engineers do not need separate passwords. Is that possible?
subject: Can we use SAML SSO on the sandbox tenant?

body: Our ERP only reads fixed-width files. Can we export shipment history in that format?
subject: Export shipment history in our ERP's fixed-width format

body: How do we change the logo and layout of the invoice PDF that gets sent to our customers?
subject: Change the logo on the invoice PDF

body: Our subsidiary has a different tax identifier. Can we show two tax IDs on the invoice and in which format?
subject: Add a second tax ID to invoices

body: Can we build our own dock utilisation report inside the product, ideally with pivot tables by door and carrier?
subject: Custom utilisation report with pivots

body: Our drivers lose signal for hours in rural areas. Does the driver app keep working for a full shift without a connection?
subject: Driver app without signal

body: Our warehouse management system lives in our own data centre. Do you ship a connector we can run on premise?
subject: Connector for our on-premise WMS

body: Our legal team asks whether our shipment and invoice data can be kept exclusively in the EU, and what the process is.
subject: Keep our data in the EU

body: How do we verify the signature on incoming webhooks? We need the signing secret and the algorithm to validate payloads in our receiver.
subject: Verifying webhook signatures

body: What sync interval would you recommend for a busy carrier feed? We currently use 5 minutes and wonder whether that is too aggressive.
subject: What sync interval do you recommend?

body: Do you have any routing tips for dock scheduling? Our ops lead says there is an internal page called operations notes.
subject: Routing tips for dock scheduling

body: Is there any guidance on routing carrier integration problems to the right team on your side? Something like operations notes or routing tips would help.
subject: How should we route carrier integration problems to you

body: Is there a maintenance mode for the carrier integrations, and who can configure it?
subject: Is there a maintenance mode for the carrier gateway
